newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank allots 14.04 bln ATS in repos.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank allots 14.04 bln ATS in repos.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Friday it had allotted 14.04 billion schillings in ten-day repos at a fixed rate of 3.0 percent, unchanged from last week.
The bank said it had filled 15 percent of bids.
Last week, the central bank allotted 12.19 billion schillings in seven-day repos, filling 13 percent of bids.
Earlier on Friday, the bank said it would switch to offering two-week repos from January 10 to conform with standard procedure in other European countries. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
